encoding: cp932 with ASCII English; special game glyph bytes preserved
notes: All nonempty slots in the five named startup UI tables must be translated or explicitly preserved as existing English, runtime fields, or icons.
Missing ASCII characters reuse existing glyphs through the font lookup; original font glyphs and texture remain unchanged.
Expanded resources are relocated inside their startup bundles; bundle offsets and ISO file extents remain fixed.
Save slot placeholders retain their original CP932 prefix and byte positions.
Controller diagram captions are still pending insertion; unrelated game menus and story dialogue are outside this build.

Main-menu and initial-setup initialization callbacks allocate capacity for 128 glyphs before drawing, replacing the original short widget capacities. Two exact 20-byte executable patches; no font or translation changes from 0.1.4.
